notes: Loadout 2: Cleaver with ShieldBarrel and ShieldBarrelStraps. One export per loadout, since each weapon has its own grip.

Clips are baked from the rig's evaluated pose (grips, the fist's hold on the shield, forearm twist, the chain and the loincloth flaps); no constraints or drivers go out. The props are skinned to the bones Weapon (child of mixamorig:RightHand) and Shield (child of mixamorig:LeftForeArm).

Locomotion is in place. walk moves the figure by root_vel (m/s, Godot axes): the travel retarget_clips.py removed (travel_from); speed_footlock_mps is how fast his planted foot slides back. idle stands still. The death keeps its authored travel on the hips (root_motion true, hips_drift); do not add it again.
attack: events.contact is when the weapon's tip is furthest forward after the swing's top (tip_reach_m from where he stood, at tip_height_m); events.swing spans the blow.
No hit clip: the sandbox flinches procedurally.
Godot imports every clip with loop mode none; set it from clips.<clip>.loop. Animation names equal the clip names (clips.<clip>.anim).
